## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 is unsupported by artifact `1d1b895868417f4382ef0bed0c68de90d3eed840b1441ecdcff8a71abfd2d5bd`. The artifact supplies Pieri matrices and Smith diagonals, but no target vectors \(e_{R_{\rho'}}-(-1)^{|\rho|}e_{L_\rho}\), no integral coefficient vectors \(c_\rho\), and no verified equations \(c_\rho^TM_{9+|\rho|}=v_\rho\).
- The Smith data do not imply the required membership because the relevant row lattices have positive-rank quotients. In particular, no witnesses are given for \(\bar s_{553}-\bar s_{33322}\) or \(\bar s_{555}-\bar s_{33333}\).
- The zero boundary case is described prospectively but not included in a verified ten-case witness table.
- claim-2 is a correct limitation statement, but it does not establish the requested certificate.

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Provide one exact machine-checkable table for all ten \(\rho\subseteq3^2\), including \(\rho=\varnothing\), containing each ordered Schur basis, target vector, complete labelled Pieri rows, an integral vector \(c_\rho\), and verification of
  \[
  c_\rho^TM_{9+|\rho|}
  =e_{R_{\rho'}}-(-1)^{|\rho|}e_{L_\rho}.
  \]
  Require \(c_\varnothing=0\), and verify that every used row is \(h_t\bar s_\lambda\) with \(1\le t\le5\) and \(333\subseteq\lambda\subseteq5^5\).
